Container.Name: spamfilter-rspamd
Container.Overview: rspamd scanner for the IMAP spam filter stack. Reads its `local.d` config from the mounted appdata directory. bootstrap.sh prepares a fully-rendered worker-controller.inc on the host beforehand (no env-var coordination needed at container start). Listens on 11333 (scan) and 11334 (control + web UI). Run bootstrap.sh once before installing this container.
Container.Requires: Run unraid/bootstrap.sh first (creates the spamnet network, the appdata layout, and the rspamd controller password file).

Config.Name: Controller UI
Config.Description: rspamd controller HTTP (UI + /learn endpoints). Bind only to LAN or 127.0.0.1.

Config.Name: local.d configs
Config.Description: Mounted read-only at /etc/rspamd/local.d. Filled by bootstrap.sh.

Config.Name: rspamd state
Config.Description: rspamd-managed runtime state (caches). Does not need backup.
